ablation_semantics.full: apply all frozen policy rules in order
ablation_semantics.no_dls: ignore dls_coherence while preserving repeat, temporal, entropy, and fallback rules
ablation_semantics.no_entropy: skip the entropy_bits rule while preserving structural and temporal rules
ablation_semantics.no_temporal: skip the temporal_mad rule while preserving structural and entropy rules
ablation_semantics.offline_oracle_non_deployable: per clip, choose the configuration with the lowest sum of pointwise bytes among configurations passing both quality floors at all four CRF points; ties use configuration name

elementary_stream.determinism_requirement: all three trials must have identical payload SHA-256
elementary_stream.hash: SHA-256 over concatenated AV1 frame payload bytes, excluding IVF file and frame headers

promotion_rule: mean PSNR-Y BD-rate < 0 and mean SSIM-Y BD-rate < 0 with at least 4/6 clips non-positive on both metrics; report attribution separately
